kinds.name: Mix test
kinds.answers: what each change does on its own, and whether they work better together

kinds.name: Story test
kinds.answers: whether details about a person or situation change how people judge it

kinds.name: Choice test
kinds.answers: which features make people choose one option over another, and what they'll trade for what; with price as a feature, what they'll pay

kinds.name: Line-up test
kinds.answers: how several versions compare when each person sees all of them

kinds.name: Head-to-head
kinds.answers: which items in a long list are strongest, ranked from best to worst

kinds.name: Priority test
kinds.answers: which items in a long list matter most, and by how much

kinds.name: Shelf test
kinds.answers: what people pick when they face many options at once, as they would in a shop, and how a change shifts that

kinds.name: Context test
kinds.answers: whether what people see or hear first changes their answer

kinds.name: Sensitive count
kinds.answers: how common something is when people won't admit to it directly

kinds.name: Baseline
kinds.answers: where people stand now, with nothing compared
